csv.import.help: Upload a spreadsheet exported as CSV. Each row becomes a person with a birthday event. Existing people are never changed.

settings.notifications.intro: Choose which channels reach you and review their delivery health.

reminder_action.title: Reminder action
reminder_action.ack_explain: This occurrence will be marked as handled and will not be reminded again.
reminder_action.done_ack: This occurrence is marked as handled. No further reminders will be sent for it.
reminder_action.done_snooze: Reminders for this occurrence are paused.
people.reminder_stages_help: Lead times in days before the date, separated by commas, e.g. 7, 1. Leave empty to use the global reminder stages.
people.reminder_stages_invalid: Reminder days must be 1 to 10 whole numbers between 1 and 365, separated by commas, e.g. 7, 1.
settings.reminder_digest_help: Send one combined reminder per channel per day instead of one message per event.
portable.title: Portable data export
portable.help: Download one human-readable JSON document with people, groups, events, gift ideas, tags, relationships, notes and recurring rules. Credentials and internal identifiers are never included.
portable.export_hint: The download is a dated JSON file you can keep, diff or import into another Datey instance.
portable.file_hint: Upload a file previously exported from Datey. Import is additive: existing records are never changed or deleted.
portable.problems: The file could not be used
portable.conflict: Different content, will be kept as-is
portable.confirm_hint: Nothing has been saved yet. Only missing records are created.
people.timezone_help: Used to count days for this person's dates. Leave on the instance default to follow the server's zone.
people.timezone_invalid: Unknown time zone. Use an IANA name such as Europe/Berlin.
subscriptions.title: Calendar subscriptions
subscriptions.intro: Remote iCalendar feeds that Datey keeps in sync automatically. Events from a subscription are updated or removed when the feed changes; events you created manually are never touched.
subscriptions.name: Name
subscriptions.delete_confirm: Delete this subscription? Its imported events are kept but will no longer update.
subscriptions.empty: No subscriptions yet. Add an ICS feed URL to start syncing.
subscriptions.add_help: The feed is fetched on a schedule and on manual refresh. Only events with a UID can be synced.
subscriptions.error_name_url: Name and feed URL are required.
subscriptions.error_url: Feed URL must be an absolute http(s) URL.
subscriptions.deleted: Subscription deleted. Its events were kept.

notifications.newitems_help: Get notified when someone else adds a new person or event.
